title: feat(web): show recent triage stats in the repository panel
body:
Second step of the repository stats (CL-XXXX) and the last piece of the agreed panel design.

- A stats strip under the repository byline, read once per repository through the panel's store from the stats route and persisted so it renders at once on reload: Triaged (with a sparkline once three days have data, and "since date" when the record is shorter than the window), Needed you, Acted on with the comment count, and Median to verdict. Two tiles a row, which is what reads cleanly at panel width. With nothing triaged it shows one muted line, never zeros; nothing renders while loading or on error.
- A check's popover shows "Passed N of M this week" when the check ran; an action row shows "Fired N times, M done" when it fired.

Verified: `bun run check`; web tests: the strip, popover and row render from one stats response, persisted stats render from the cache after a reload under the exact key, and the empty case renders only the one line; and the real panel on a local hub with a recorded verdict: strip, popover line, cached reload, and a 390px layout with no sideways scroll.

Refs CL-XXXX
